Title: Optimize Database Indexes for Search
Description:
⏳ READY TO START: Database optimization for wildcard searches

**Problem:** Slow search performance impacting user experience
- Customer wildcard searches: 3,500ms (P95: 3,892ms)
- Product searches: 1,700ms (P95)

**Impact:** Poor user experience, high database load

**Solution:** Add trigram indexes (pg_trgm) + B-tree indexes

**Expected Improvement:**
- Customer search: 3,500ms → <1,000ms (71% improvement)
- Product search: 1,700ms → <800ms (53% improvement)

**Implementation:**
- Create migration: add_search_indexes.sql
- Enable pg_trgm extension
- Add trigram indexes on name, sku, company_name, contact_name
- Add B-tree indexes on foreign keys (customer_id, product_id, status)
- Add composite indexes for common query patterns

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- All indexes created without errors
- Customer search <1,000ms (95th percentile)
- Product search <800ms (95th percentile)
- No write performance regression
- Database size increase <500MB

**Business Value:** Improve user satisfaction, reduce database CPU by 70%+

**Priority:** High - Affects daily user experience
